0022600204.text: The Charlotte Hornets host the Cleveland Cavaliers at 3-7 and on a six-game losing streak, with a 2-4 home record and 11th place in the East, three games behind the Southeast leaders. Cleveland comes in at 5-4 on a one-game winning streak, sitting sixth in the East and 1.5 games back in the Central. Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps), and Brandon Miller is day-to-day with groin soreness. The teams have not met yet this season, and Cleveland won the last meeting 118-113 in Charlotte, part of a 3-1 Cavaliers series win in 2025-26.
